evals.name: full-severity-ranked-review
evals.prompt: can you go through design_v2.md and tell me everything that would make an engineer stop and guess? i want it severity ranked, and for each one tell me exactly what the doc has to say instead. don't bother with backward-compat stuff, that's out of scope on purpose.
evals.expected_output: A findings report grouped HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW, each finding using the exact header format '[Severity]-[Category] — title — line(s)' with four labeled parts (the rule the doc must state / conflicting locations / why it blocks / exact fix), followed by 'Silent Coverage Gaps' and 'External-Context Dependencies' sections. Reviewed in one pass with no subagent fan-out, since the doc is short. Should test at least one closure claim ('never', 'only', 'from these rules alone') and check every term used against the Terms section.

evals.name: post-edit-crossref-drift
evals.prompt: I changed how a claim ends in design_v2.md and I think I forgot to update the other places that mention it. Can you check whether anything drifted?
evals.expected_output: Must diff the doc first, list the changed rule and its old wording, then grep the WHOLE doc (Terms, Track power, Switches, Review checklist) for the old wording. Should report each stale site with line citations on both sides.

evals.name: evening-test-review
evals.prompt: is design_v2.md drifting back toward v1? check whether any rule in it is there because a real railway has it rather than because my evening needs it.
evals.expected_output: Applies the doc's evening test to every rule, reports any rule that fails it as M-EVENING-TEST with the line and the plain question 'what does the evening lose if this rule is deleted?', and does not cite archive/design_new.md as a source of rules.
